title: 1082837: independent identity review; latest 79.0% market line still uses Alianza name
detail: Independent follow-up to the already-published 093e722e identity flag (2026-10-21). Hotspawn 1082837 and HLTV 2399865 identify the 22:00Z CCT South America Series 7 round-5 BO3 as Zetta vs LOS NINOS and publish the same five-player core; Valve VRS roster evidence supports continuity but does not itself announce an Alianza rebrand. Polymarket market 6001634 and Kalshi event KXCS2GAME-26OCT211800LNALE identify the same slot as Alianza Lima Esports vs Los Niños/Los Ninos. The latest successful 20:52:48Z public snapshot displays LOS NINOS at 79.0% from Polymarket quotes observed 20:53:11Z and Kalshi quotes observed 20:53:12Z (23.5%/76.5% and 18.4615%/81.5385%). Direct first-party checks at 20:57–20:58Z replayed the same Polymarket CLOB and active Kalshi event books. The earlier 20:20Z snapshot was 60.9%; the price movement does not prove team identity. The quote inputs and arithmetic are supportable, but no first-party Alianza/CCT statement confirming an acquisition or rebrand was found and Strafe lists both labels among event participants (secondary evidence). The audit does not endorse the alias-dependent estimate until the team/contract join is authoritatively adjudicated. No alias or pick was edited. See the linked dossier for exact source values, timestamps, evidence grades, and limitations.
